questions.question: King Ahab of Israel wanted the city of Ramoth-gilead. What did he ask King Jehoshaphat of Judah to do?

answers.text: Go fight for it with him
Pay Aram a price for it
Ask Aram's king to give it up

questions.question: When King Ahab asked his four hundred prophets about going to war, what did they tell him?

answers.text: Go up and the Lord will give the city to the king
Stay home and leave the city to Aram
Wait until Judah's army grows bigger

questions.question: In the prophet Micaiah's vision of the LORD on His throne, what did the LORD ask?

answers.text: Who will entice Ahab to fall at Ramoth-gilead
Who will warn Ahab to stay out of the war
Who will fight for Israel at Ramoth-gilead

questions.question: The prophet Micaiah told King Ahab that if Ahab ever returned safely from battle, the LORD had not spoken through him. True or false?
